# Colecto v0.11.7

Patch release fixing Android (AGP 9.3.1) and Windows (MSVC 14.52 / Visual Studio 2026) release builds for the new sandboxed platform WebView HTML email renderer introduced in `v0.11.6`.

## Changes

- **Android release build fix**: Patched `flutter_inappwebview_android` (`proguard-android.txt` → `proguard-android-optimize.txt`) in `app/android/settings.gradle.kts` via `gradle.beforeProject` for Android Gradle Plugin 9.3.1 compatibility.
- **Windows release build fix**: Added `_SILENCE_EXPERIMENTAL_COROUTINE_DEPRECATION_WARNINGS` in `app/windows/CMakeLists.txt` so `flutter_inappwebview_windows` compiles cleanly under MSVC 14.52 / Visual Studio 2026 with C++17.
- **Includes all `v0.11.6` reader & performance improvements**: Lazy, sandboxed platform WebViews (Linux WebKitGTK 4.1, Windows/macOS/Android/iOS `flutter_inappwebview`, Web `<iframe sandbox>`), sanitized `<style>` CSS preservation in Rust, instant message open, and a 4-worker parallel FFI isolate pool.
